documentPolicyScope.validDirection: UpperLine is a feature boundary, not an area quota; finite palette colours are a separate final lookup.
documentPolicyScope.notUniversalProof: One row per global screen column is not rotation covariant or always8-connected. Prototype uses existing registered canonical eye grid.
documentPolicyScope.strictProseVersusEquation: The document also allows below-boundary UpperLine when I+W=0; that exception differs from strict one-per-column. This test implements the strict boundary prose only.
documentPolicyScope.colour: Nearest prototype labels give a total colour assignment, not connected spatial regions. Medoid counts/thresholds and weak-blush merge are style policy, not proven universal noise thresholds. P[r,q] implies equal output only when r/q and encoding are equal.
documentPolicyScope.current108Correction: 108/110 do not impose ceil(lid_mass) as an adopted hard upper bound; the conflict was diagnostic.110 already has no such quota.
